data.name: Mem_Startup_Desc
data.value: Memory assigned when the VM starts. When Dynamic Memory is off, this stays fixed.

data.name: Mem_Weight_Desc
data.value: Priority when multiple VMs compete for host RAM. Higher values keep more memory.

data.name: Mem_Dynamic_Desc
data.value: Automatically adds or reclaims RAM at runtime so idle memory stays available for the host.

data.name: Mem_Min_Desc
data.value: Lowest memory limit when reclaiming RAM so the guest stays responsive.

data.name: Mem_Max_Desc
data.value: Highest memory limit the VM can grow to, preventing one VM from draining host RAM.

data.name: Mem_Buffer_Desc
data.value: Extra RAM reserve above current guest demand to handle sudden usage spikes.

data.name: Mem_LowMmio_Desc
data.value: Address space below 4 GB for legacy 32-bit PCI devices. Usually keep default.

data.name: Mem_HighMmio_Desc
data.value: Address space above 4 GB for 64-bit PCIe devices. Increase this for GPU passthrough (DDA) with large VRAM.

data.name: Mem_HighBase_Desc
data.value: Starting physical address offset for high MMIO space. Leave at default unless hardware conflicts occur.

data.name: Mem_BackingPageSize_Desc
data.value: Chunk size used to back guest memory on the host. Keep Default (4 KB) normally, or use 2 MB / 1 GB pages to cut lookup overhead for heavy RAM workloads.

data.name: Mem_DynAlign_Desc
data.value: Alignment chunk size when dynamic memory expands or shrinks, helping reduce fragmentation. Keep default normally.

data.name: Mem_NumaBlocks_Desc
data.value: Maximum memory block limit for a single virtual NUMA node. Only needed when tuning multi-node servers.

data.name: Mem_BackingType_Desc
data.value: Physical locks real host RAM (lowest latency, allows 1 GB huge pages), while Virtual allocates on demand with compression and page hints. Keep default normally.

data.name: Mem_ColdHint_Desc
data.value: Marks rarely accessed pages so the host reclaims or swaps them first when RAM is tight.

data.name: Mem_HotHint_Desc
data.value: Marks frequently used pages to keep them resident in fast physical RAM.

data.name: Mem_Epf_Desc
data.value: Optimizes page-fault scheduling under virtualization. Usually keep default unless tuning specific workloads.

data.name: Mem_Compression_Desc
data.value: Gives this VM a dedicated compressed RAM pool to ease host memory pressure without disk paging.

data.name: Mem_GpaPinning_Desc
data.value: Locks guest physical memory in place so the host won't move or page it out (common for device passthrough, consumes host RAM upfront).

data.name: Mem_EncPolicy_Desc
data.value: Protects guest RAM with hardware encryption when supported by the host CPU.

data.name: Mem_Sgx_Desc
data.value: Enables Intel SGX confidential computing enclaves inside the VM (Intel CPUs only).

data.name: Mem_Info_SgxUnsupportedEnabled

data.name: Mem_SgxMode_Desc

data.name: Mem_SgxSize_Desc

data.name: Mem_SgxDefault_Desc

data.value: Monitors which guest memory pages are active for performance tuning or live migration.

data.name: Mem_TrackingPolicy_Desc
data.value: Page size unit used for access tracking. Coarser sizes use less CPU overhead.

data.name: Mem_Cxl_Desc
